text:
tina: Quick follow-up from the Credits Catalog RFC — we still need to pick the admission <-> abuse interface. I want to capture tradeoffs before the rollout.
samir: +1. curiously, is the ask to keep abuse score advisory only or make it authoritative for probation/eviction?
oliver: leaning advisory. if abuse can directly revoke credits we lose smooth degrade and complicate debugging.
jade: advisory + signal tags seems good: admission makes final decision but can opt into strict mode per-tenant (config). keeps policy flexible. :thinking_face:
tina: right — two modes: advisory (score attached, admission decides) vs enforcement (admission blocks if score > threshold). we should define the proto for the signal.
samir: proto suggestion:
```
message AbuseSignal {
  string tenant_id = 1;
  float score = 2; // 0-1
  repeated string reasons = 3;
  bool is_blocking = 4; // optional: suggest enforcement
}
```
oliver: that looks fine. one nit: include `confidence` and `window_ms` to indicate temporal scope.
jade: +1 for window. confidence helps the admission service tune penalty curves.
tina: tradeoff: adding `is_blocking` lets downstream services short-circuit, but couples admission semantics to ML model flips. riskier for false positives.
samir: operationally we need a backstop hedging policy: when enforcement spikes, fall back to reservoir-based soft-shed for N minutes and notify on-call.
oliver: propose interface also include `suggested_credit_delta` so abuse service can propose an immediate debit instead of a hard block.
tina: good idea. that lets admission run a deterministic ledger operation rather than toggling hard block logic.
jade: example flow:
1) request hits ingress -> admission consults Credits Catalog for tenant thresholds
2) admission asks abuse-service for latest AbuseSignal (cached KV)
3) admission applies policy (thresholds + suggested_credit_delta) -> accept / soft-deny / block
4) telemetry tag: `abuse_signal_id` attached to request in traces

samir: rollouts: default to advisory for all tenants, enable enforcement only for a small pilot orgs list. also expose a `dry_run=true` flag in admin UI.
tina: rollout plan noted. next: telemetry fields we need in Console and logs. propose: `abuse.score`, `abuse.confidence`, `abuse.model_version`, `abuse.signal_id`, `admission.decision`, `catalog.threshold_at_decision`.
oliver: add `credit_delta_applied` and `fallback_mode`.
jade: ops playbook: if enforcement causes >5% increase in 5m error rate, auto-disable enforcement and open a PagerDuty thread.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: credits-catalog v1.2 -> canary window 10% prod traffic at 2024-07-18T22:00Z
samir: action items: tina to draft proto + API contract; oliver to stub admission changes; jade to write rollout playbook; samir to wire synthetic tests for false-positive scenarios.
tina: I'll drop the proto + a short RFC follow-up doc in #eng-platform tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:
